question:
A School Day

It was Monday morning. The alarm clock __(1)__ at 6:30. I got out of bed quickly, washed my face, and put on my school uniform. After a quick breakfast, I picked up my schoolbag and rushed to the bus stop.

The bus was crowded as usual. I found a seat near the window and started to __(2)__ my English words for the coming test. The bus ride took about twenty minutes, and soon I arrived at school.

Our first class was math. Mr. Wang, our math teacher, walked into the classroom with a big smile on his face. "Good morning, everyone! Today we are going to learn something new and __(3)__," he said. Actually, the lesson was about geometry (几何), which I found quite difficult. However, Mr. Wang explained everything so clearly that even I could understand it.

During the break, my best friend Li Hua came to me. "Did you watch the basketball game last night?" he asked __(4)__. "No, I went to bed early to prepare for today's test," I replied. Li Hua looked disappointed but then said, "Don't worry. Our team won!"

The English test was in the fourth period. When I got the paper, I felt a little __(5)__ at first because there were some words I had never seen before. But then I remembered what our teacher always told us: "If you don't know one question, move on to the next one." I followed her advice and finished the test on time.

Lunchtime was my favorite part of the day. The cafeteria served tomato and egg noodles — my __(6)__ dish! I sat with my classmates and we talked about everything from homework to movies.

In the afternoon, we had PE class. We played soccer on the playground. I am not good at sports, but I still enjoy __(7)__ with my friends. Running around and laughing together makes me forget all my worries.

When the last bell rang at 5:00 p.m., I felt tired but satisfied. School is not always easy, but every day brings something new. I packed my bag, said goodbye to my friends, and headed home, __(8)__ that tomorrow would be another meaningful day.
options: (1) A. went off B. went on C. went away D. went by
(2) A. review B. remember C. recite D. repeat
(3) A. boring B. difficult C. interesting D. terrible
(4) A. angrily B. sadly C. excitedly D. carefully
(5) A. happy B. nervous C. angry D. sleepy
(6) A. worst B. best C. only D. favorite
(7) A. myself B. ourselves C. themselves D. yourself
(8) A. hoping B. worrying C. complaining D. wondering
analysis:
(1) A【考查短语辨析】went off（闹钟响）是固定搭配，表示闹钟在指定时间响起；went on表示继续；went away表示离开；went by表示时间流逝。句意：闹钟在6:30响了。
(2) A【考查动词辨析】review复习，符合语境——在公交车上为即将到来的考试复习单词；remember记住（强调结果）；recite背诵；repeat重复。此处强调备考过程中的复习行为。
(3) C【考查形容词辨析】根据老师smile和something new可知应选积极词汇interesting；boring/difficult/terrible均为消极词，与老师微笑的语境不符。
(4) C【考查副词辨析】excitedly兴奋地，符合谈论赢球时的情绪；angrily生气地；sadly伤心地；carefully仔细地。从后文Li Hua说"我们队赢了！"可推断他是兴奋地问。
(5) B【考查形容词辨析】nervous紧张的，符合考试时看到生词的正常反应；happy高兴的与语境矛盾；angry生气的无依据；sleepy困倦的不合逻辑。
(6) D【考查形容词辨析】favorite最喜欢的，my favorite dish我最喜欢的菜，固定表达；worst最差的；best最好的（语法上可以但不如favorite地道）；only唯一的。
(7) A【考查反身代词】enjoy oneself玩得开心，主语是I，故用myself；ourselves对应we；themselves对应they；yourself对应you。
(8) A【考查动词辨析】hoping希望，符合积极结尾的基调——期待明天也是充实的一天；worrying担心；complaining抱怨；wondering想知道。文章整体态度积极向上。

question:
Family Love

Last Sunday was Mother's Day. I wanted to do something special for my mom, but I didn't have much __(1)__ to buy an expensive gift. So I decided to make a gift by myself.

I got up early in the morning while Mom was still sleeping. I went to the kitchen and started to __(2)__ breakfast for her. I knew how to make fried eggs and toast because Mom had taught me before. I cooked carefully, __(3)__ not to burn anything.

After breakfast was ready, I made a card with some colorful paper. I drew a heart on it and wrote inside: "Mom, thank you for everything you do for me. You are the __(4)__ mother in the world." It took me nearly an hour to finish the card because I wanted every word to be __(5)__.

Then I cleaned the living room and watered the flowers on the balcony. By the time Mom woke up, the house was tidy and there was a hot meal __(6)__ on the table.

When she came into the kitchen, she was very surprised. "What's going on?" she asked with big eyes. "Happy Mother's Day!" I said and gave her the card. She opened it and read it __(7)___. To my surprise, tears came to her eyes. "This is the most beautiful gift I have ever received," she said softly.

We had breakfast together and talked for a long time. Mom told me stories about when she was young. I learned that being a mother is not __(8)__—it requires patience, love, and a lot of hard work.

That day, I understood something important. Gifts don't have to be expensive. What truly matters is the love behind them. And I promised myself that I would not just show my love on Mother's Day, but every single day of the year.
options: (1) A. time B. money C. energy D. idea
(2) A. eat B. cook C. buy D. order
(3) A. trying B. wanting C. hoping D. making
(4) A. busiest B. kindest C. strictest D. tallest
(5) A. short B. long C. perfect D. simple
(6) A. waiting B. standing C. lying D. running
(7) A. quickly B. loudly C. slowly D. happily
(8) A. tiring B. exciting C. relaxing D. easy
analysis:
(1) B【考查名词辨析】money钱，didn't have much money没钱买昂贵礼物，是做礼物的常见原因；time时间（后面说起了大早有时间）；energy精力；idea主意。但买礼物缺的是钱不是时间或精力。
(2) B【考查动词辨析】cook做饭，cook breakfast做早餐；eat吃（早餐已做好不用吃）；buy买；order点餐。在家自己准备早餐用cook。
(3) A【考查动词搭配】try not to do sth尽量不做某事，固定用法。try not to burn anything尽量不烧糊任何东西。want/hope不接not to do作目的状语；make不符合句意。
(4) C【考查形容词最高级】kindest最善良的，the kindest mother世上最善良的妈妈，母亲节卡片常用语；busiest最忙的（不适合赞美）；strictest最严格的（负面）；tallest最高的（不适合描述妈妈）。
(5) C【考查形容词辨析】perfect完美的，想让每个字都完美，体现用心；short短的（不想让字少）；long长的（不是越长越好）；simple简单的（不够用心）。
(6) A【考查现在分词】waiting等待，meal waiting on the table饭菜在桌上等着，表示准备好待用；standing站（饭不会站着）；lying躺（不合常理）；running跑（不可能）。
(7) C【考查副词辨析】slowly慢慢地读，体现认真和感动的情绪；quickly快读（不合适境）；loudly大声读（不合适）；happily开心地读（有可能但slowly更能体现感动）。
(8) D【考查形容词辨析】easy容易的，being a mother is not easy当妈妈不容易，引出下文patience和hard work；tiring累人的（有道理但不如easy与hard work形成对比更紧密）；exciting令人激动的；relaxing轻松的（均不符合育儿辛苦的语境）。

question:
True Friendship

Tom and I have been best friends since primary school. We sit next to each other in class, play together after school, and share almost everything. But last week, something happened that __(1)__ our friendship.

It started with a small thing. Tom borrowed my new pen without asking me first. When I found out, I felt a little __(2)__ because this was a birthday gift from my grandma. I didn't say anything at that moment, but I was unhappy inside.

The next day, Tom __(3)__ to bring the pen back. He said he couldn't find it anywhere. I got really angry and shouted at him in front of the whole class. Tom's face turned red and he didn't say a word. He just turned and walked away.

For three days, we didn't speak to each other. Those were the __(4)__ three days I had ever experienced. I missed him terribly, but my pride stopped me from saying sorry first.

On the fourth day, our teacher Ms. Li noticed something was wrong. She called me to her office and asked what happened. I told her the __(5)__ story. After listening carefully, she smiled gently and said, "Friendship is like a glass ball. Once broken, it can be fixed, but the cracks will always remain. So cherish (珍惜) your friends."

Her words hit me hard. I realized that a pen was not worth losing my best friend. That afternoon, I went to find Tom. Before I could say anything, he took something out of his pocket—it was my pen! "I finally __(6)__ it behind my bookshelf," he said shyly. "I'm really sorry."

I looked at the pen, then at Tom, and suddenly all my anger disappeared. "I'm sorry too," I said. "I shouldn't have shouted at you in class."

We smiled at each other and everything was __(7)__ again. From this experience, I learned a valuable __(8)__: communication is the key to any relationship, and pride should never come between friends.
options: (1) A. built B. tested C. ended D. improved
(2) A. happy B. excited C. upset D. surprised
(3) A. refused B. forgot C. hoped D. managed
(4) A. happiest B. longest C. shortest D. saddest
(5) A. false B. whole C. funny D. short
(6) A. bought B. threw C. found D. lost
(7) A. different B. strange C. normal D. broken
(8) A. decision B. lesson C. rule D. secret
analysis:
(1) B【考查动词辨析】test考验，指这件事考验了他们的友谊；built建立（与but转折矛盾）；ended结束（最终没结束）；improve改善（事情刚发生还没改善）。
(2) C【考查形容词辨析】upset难过的、心烦的，借走生日礼物且未先询问让人心烦；happy/excited与语境相反；surprised惊讶的（他知道Tom会借东西）。
(3) B【考查动词辨析】forgot忘记（带回来），forgot to bring忘了带回；refused拒绝（不符后文找不到的说法）；hoped希望（不合语境）；managed设法（通常接成功做的事）。
(4) D【考查形容词最高级】saddest最难过的，冷战三天非常痛苦；happiest最快乐的（相反）；longest最长的（时间上对但情感不对）；shortest最短的（三天不算短）。
(5) B【考查形容词辨析】whole整个的，tell the whole story讲完整的事；false假的；funny有趣的；short短的。向老师说明情况应该讲完整经过。
(6) C【考查动词辨析】found找到，finally found it终于找到了；bought买；threw扔；lost丢（前面已经丢了）。从后文还笔的情节可知是找到了。
(7) C【考查形容词辨析】normal正常的，一切恢复正常；different不同的；strange奇怪的；broken破碎的。友谊修复后回到正常状态。
(8) B【考查名词辨析】lesson教训、经验，learned a valuable lesson学到宝贵的一课；decision决定；rule规则；secret秘密。从经历中学习用lesson。

question:
Learning Experience

English has always been my weakest subject. When I was in Grade 7, I could barely understand what the teacher said in class. My pronunciation was terrible, and I was too __(1)__ to speak English in front of others. Every time the teacher asked a question, I lowered my head, hoping she wouldn't call my name.

One day, a new student named Sarah joined our class. She had lived in America for two years and spoke English __(2)___. When she answered questions, everyone listened carefully. Her pronunciation was perfect, and she seemed so confident.

I admired Sarah, but I also felt __(3)___. Why was she so good while I was so poor? I started to wonder if I would ever be able to speak English well.

__(4)__, I decided to make a change. I bought an English notebook and wrote down five new words every day. Every morning, I read aloud for fifteen minutes before going to school. At first, it felt strange to talk to myself, but I kept doing it.

Two months later, our teacher announced that there would be an English speech contest. Everyone had to __(5)__. My heart beat fast when I heard the news. Part of me wanted to give up, but another part told me to try.

I chose a topic called "My Dream" and practiced every evening in my room. I recorded my speech, listened to it, and __(6)__ my pronunciation again and again. Sometimes I felt frustrated and wanted to stop, but I thought about Sarah's confidence and continued practicing.

The day of the contest arrived. When it was my turn, I walked to the stage with __(7)__ legs. I took a deep breath and began to speak. At first, my voice shook a little, but after a few sentences, I became more and more __(8)___.

options: (1) A. proud B. shy C. lazy D. busy
(2) A. poorly B. slowly C. fluently D. quietly
(3) A. happy B. lucky C. jealous D. worried
(4) A. However B. Therefore C. Besides D. Instead
(5) A. leave B. join C. prepare D. participate
(6) A. enjoyed B. changed C. forgot D. corrected
(7) A. strong B. weak C. long D. short
(8) A. nervous B. afraid C. confident D. careful
analysis:
(1) B【考查形容词辨析】shy害羞的，too shy to speak太害羞而不敢说英语，符合不敢发言的情境；proud骄傲的（相反）；lazy懒的（不是因为懒不说话）；busy忙的（无关）。
(2) C【考查副词辨析】fluently流利地，在美国生活过两年所以英语流利；poorly差地；slowly慢地；quietly安静地。均不符合在美国生活过的背景。
(3) C【考查形容词辨析】jealous羡慕的、嫉妒的，羡慕别人比自己好同时感到自卑；happy开心的（不应感到消极）；lucky幸运的（不构成心理冲突）；worried担心的（方向偏了）。
(4) A【考查连词辨析】However然而，表转折——虽然感到差距但决定改变；Therefore因此；Besides此外；Instead代替。前后是转折关系。
(5) D【考查动词辨析】participate参加，everyone had to participate每个人都必须参加比赛；leave离开；join加入（及物动词需加宾语）；prepare准备（不够具体）。
(6) D【考查动词辨析】corrected纠正、改正，corrected my pronunciation反复纠正发音；enjoyed享受；changed改变；forgot忘记。录音听后纠正是练习方法。
(7) C【考查形容词辨析】weak弱的、发软的，with weak legs双腿发软，形容紧张时的生理反应；strong强壮的（紧张时不会强壮）；long长的；short短的（腿的长短不会因紧张变化）。
(8) C【考查形容词辨析】confident自信的，越来越自信，与开头的shy形成呼应对比；nervous紧张的（开头状态）；afraid害怕的（开头状态）；careful仔细的（不是演讲中的主要变化）。

question:
Sports & Health

Last year, I was one of the __(1)__ students in my class. I weighed much more than I should, and climbing stairs made me out of breath. My doctor told me that I needed to lose weight and exercise more, or I would face serious health problems in the future.

At first, I found many __(2)__ not to exercise. "I'm too busy with homework," or "The weather is too cold," or "I'll start tomorrow." Days turned into weeks, and weeks turned into months. Nothing changed.

One morning, my dad came into my room and said, "Let's go for a run together." I wanted to say no, but the look in his eyes told me that he was __(3)__. So I put on my running shoes and followed him outside.

That first run was __(4)__. After only five hundred meters, I could hardly breathe. My legs felt heavy, and I wanted to give up. But Dad ran beside me and said, "Keep going. Don't think about how far you have to go. Just think about the next step."

I followed his advice and focused on putting one foot in __(5)__ of the other. Slowly, I found my rhythm (节奏). We ran for twenty minutes that day—a small victory for me.

The next morning, my legs hurt so much that I could __(6)__ walk. But I remembered how good it felt to finish that run, so I went out again. Day after day, running became part of my daily routine.

Three months later, something amazing happened. I stepped on a scale (体重秤) and found that I had lost ten kilograms! More importantly, I felt __(7)__ and full of energy. Climbing stairs was no longer a problem, and I could even run three kilometers without stopping.

Now, running is my favorite activity. I have learned that health is the most __(8)__ thing we have. Without it, nothing else matters. If you want to change your life, start with a single step—literally!
options: (1) A. thinnest B. strongest C. heaviest D. tallest
(2) A. reasons B. ways C. chances D. places
(3) A. angry B. serious C. happy D. tired
(4) A. enjoyable B. relaxing C. terrible D. boring
(5) A. back B. front C. time D. spite
(6) A. easily B. clearly C. hardly D. quickly
(7) A. weaker B. sadder C. angrier D. healthier
(8) A. useless B. important C. dangerous D. difficult
analysis:
(1) C【考查形容词最高级】heaviest最重的，超重学生的典型特征；thinnest最瘦的（相反）；strongest最强壮的（不需要减肥）；tallest最高的（身高不是减肥原因）。
(2) A【考查名词辨析】reasons理由、借口，find excuses/reasons not to do sth找借口不做某事；ways方法；chances机会；places地方。后面列举的都是借口。
(3) B【考查形容词辨析】serious认真的，父亲眼神透露出他是认真的（不容拒绝）；angry生气的（没有吵架迹象）；happy开心的（不需要说服）；tired累的（不相关）。
(4) C【考查形容词辨析】terrible糟糕的，第一次跑步只有500米就喘不上气，体验很糟；enjoyable愉快的；relaxating放松的；boring无聊的。虽然有道理但terrible更能体现场面之艰难。
(5) B【考查固定搭配】put one foot in front of the other一步步向前走，固定表达，比喻专注当下；put...back放回；in time及时；in spite of尽管。
(6) C【考查副词辨析】hardly几乎不能，腿疼得几乎走不了路，说明运动强度大；easily容易地；clearly清楚地；quickly快速地。剧烈运动后的肌肉酸痛导致行动困难。
(7) D【考查比较级】healthier更健康的，减重10公斤后感觉更健康；weaker更弱；sadder更伤心；angrier更生气。减重的结果是健康改善。
(8) B【考查形容词最高级】最重要的，health is the most important thing健康是最重要的；useless无用的（相反）；dangerous危险的（相反）；difficult困难的（不构成价值判断）。

question:
A Memorable Trip

Last summer holiday, my parents told me that we were going to Yunnan for a trip. I had never been so __(1)__ in my life! Yunnan is famous for its beautiful mountains, clear lakes, and colorful cultures of minority groups (少数民族).

We flew to Kunming first, which is known as the "Spring City" __(2)__ its pleasant weather all year round. The temperature there was around 20°C—perfect for traveling. We visited the Stone Forest (石林), where rocks of strange shapes rise from the ground like a stone __(3)__.

From Kunming, we took a train to Dali. The train ride was about two hours, and along the way, we saw green fields, blue skies, and white clouds. Dali is a peaceful old town __(4)__ the Erhai Lake. We rented bicycles and rode around the lake. The wind blew gently on our faces, and the water shone like a mirror under the sunlight.

The next destination was Lijiang, a town __(5)__ by tourists from all over the world. The old streets there are made of stone, and houses are built in a traditional Naxi style. In the evening, we sat in a small café and listened to local folk music. The melody was so beautiful that I almost didn't want to __(6)__.

On the fifth day, we went to Shangri-La, a place whose name means "the sun and moon in the heart." The air there was thin __(7)__ the high altitude (海拔), but the scenery was breathtaking. Snow-capped mountains, green grasslands, and grazing yaks (牦牛) made me feel like I was in a painting.

__(8)__ the trip had to end. On our way back home, I looked out of the airplane window at the clouds below. This trip taught me that the world is bigger than I thought, and there is so much more to see and experience. I promised myself that I would travel more in the future.
options: (1) A. worried B. frightened C. excited D. tired
(2) A. as B. for C. with D. by
(3) A. garden B. forest C. museum D. palace
(4) A. in B. on C. by D. over
(5) A. loved B. visited C. forgotten D. hated
(6) A. sing B. dance C. leave D. sleep
(7) A. according to B. instead of C. because of D. such as
(8) A. Suddenly B. Luckily C. Hopefully D. Unluckily
analysis:
(1) C【考查形容词辨析】excited兴奋的，去旅行前从未如此兴奋；worried担心的；frightened害怕的；tired累的。去旅游的心情应该是兴奋。
(2) B【考查介词搭配】be known/famous for因……而闻名，固定搭配；as作为；with带有；by被。known as意为被称为，known for意为因…闻名。
(3) B【考查名词辨析】forest森林，石林本身就是石头形成的森林状地貌；garden花园（太小）；museum博物馆；palace宫殿。Stone Forest石林的字面意思就是石头森林。
(4) C【考查介词辨析】by在旁边，by the Erhai Lake在洱海边；in在里面（湖里面）；on在上面（水面）；over在上方（空中）。
(5) A【考查动词分词】loved被喜爱，a town loved by tourists一个受游客喜爱的小镇；visited被参观（被动但语义较弱）；forgotten被遗忘（相反）；hated被讨厌（相反）。
(6) C【考查动词辨析】leave离开，不想离开（因为音乐太好听）；sing唱歌；dance跳舞；sleep睡觉。陶醉于音乐不愿离去。
(7) C【考查介词短语】because of因为，由于海拔高所以空气稀薄；according to根据；instead of而不是；such as例如。
(8) D【考查副词辨析】Unluckily不幸地，旅行总要结束是遗憾之事；Suddenly突然地；Luckily幸运地（结束旅行不算幸运）；Hopefully充满希望地（不合适境）。

question:

analysis:
(1) B【考查介词辨析】including包括，almost everyone including students几乎所有的人包括小学生；besides除…之外还有；except除了不包括；regarding关于。including举例包含在内。
(2) C【考查名词辨析】device设备、装置，all in one small device在一个小设备里完成所有功能；box盒子；bag袋子；corner角落。智能手机是一种device。
(3) C【考查副词辨析】worriedly担心地说，妈妈对孩子沉迷手机的态度是担忧的；happily开心地；excitedly兴奋地；angrily生气地。worriedly最符合家长看到孩子变化的语气。
(4) C【考查数量表达】dozens of数十次，每小时看数十次手机（成瘾的表现）；seldom很少（不会成为问题）；never从不（不会有问题）；hundreds of数百次（过于夸张）。
(5) C【考查动词辨析】control控制，无法控制的习惯；enjoy享受；develop发展；break打破（break习惯也可以，但control更直接对应后面的let it control us主题）。
(6) D【考查形容词辨析】difficult困难的，戒掉手机习惯头几天很难熬；easy容易的（就不需要意志力了）；relaxing放松的；comfortable舒服的。戒毒式戒断反应是困难的。
(7) C【考查介词辨析】without没有，life without smartphone没有智能手机的生活也可以丰富多彩；beyond超出；within在之内；around在周围。主题是放下手机也能过好生活。
(8) A【考查固定搭配】not...而是…，should control it, not let it control我们应该控制它而不是让它控制我们，not与前面的should control形成对照；nor也不；and和；or或者。not是正确选择。

question:
Cultural Differences

Last summer, I had the opportunity to stay with an American host family (寄宿家庭) for two weeks. It was my first time living in a foreign country, and the experience __(1)__ my eyes to cultural differences.

The first shock came at the dinner table. In China, my family always shares dishes — we put all the food in the center of the table and everyone takes from the same plates. But in my American host family's home, everyone had their __(2)__ plate of food. When I reached for food on someone else's plate out of habit, the whole family looked at me in surprise.

Mealtimes were also different. In China, my grandmother always told me to eat everything on my plate — wasting food was considered __(3)__. But my host mother in America told me that I didn't have to finish everything. "Eat until you are full," she said with a smile. "It's okay to leave some food."

Another difference was how people express feelings. When I did something well, my host family praised (表扬) me very directly: "Good job!" "Amazing work!" "You're so _(4)!" At first, I felt embarrassed (尴尬的) because I wasn't used to so much praise. In China, parents and teachers tend to be more reserved (含蓄). They show love and approval (认可) through actions rather than __(5)__ words.

I also noticed differences in daily life. My host brother, who was my age, had much more __(6)__ than I did. He could decide what to wear, when to do his homework, and even what to eat for dinner. In contrast, Chinese parents, including mine, are usually more involved in their children's daily decisions.

These differences are neither good nor bad — they are just __(7)__. Understanding them helps us respect each other and communicate better. As the old saying goes: "When in Rome, do as the Romans do." But more importantly, we should also __(8)__ our own culture while learning about others.
options: (1) A. closed B. covered C. opened D. shut
(2) A. public B. shared C. own D. large
(3) A. normal B. polite C. rude D. common
(4) A. clever B. lucky C. noisy D. kind
(5) A. silent B. loud C. few D. many
(6) A. money B. freedom C. homework D. trouble
(7) A. right B. wrong C. similar D. different
(8) A. reject B. change C. value D. exchange
analysis:
(1) C【考查固定搭配】opened my eyes to让我大开眼界/让我看到了，open one's eyes to使某人了解/见识；closed闭上；covered覆盖；shut关上。open eyes to是标准搭配。
(2) C【考查形容词辨析】own自己的，每人有自己的盘子（分餐制）；public公共的；shared共用的（中式合餐）；large大的。美国家庭的分餐制特点是own plate。
(3) C【考查形容词辨析】rude粗鲁的，浪费食物在中国文化中被认为是不礼貌的；normal正常的；polite礼貌的（浪费不是礼貌的）；common常见的。中国文化中浪费=不礼貌(rude)。
(4) A【考查形容词辨析】clever聪明的，You're so smart/clever你真聪明（美国人的直接夸奖）；lucky幸运的；noisy吵闹的；kind善良的。smart/clever是对能力的夸奖。
(5) B【考查形容词辨析】loud大声的/直接的，through actions rather than loud words通过行动而非直白的言语；silent沉默的；few少的；many多的。中国父母含蓄=不loud。
(6) B【考查名词辨析】freedom自由，寄宿兄弟比我有更多自主权；money钱（同年龄差不涉及）；homework作业（不一定更多）；trouble麻烦。中美教育差异在于freedom。
(7) D【考查形容词辨析】different不同的，差异没有好坏之分只是不同；right正确的；wrong错误的；similar相似的。文化相对主义立场。
(8) C【考查动词辨析】value重视，也要重视自己的文化；reject拒绝；change改变；exchange交换。文化交流中保持对自己文化的value。

question:
Growing Up

Looking back at the past three years of middle school, I realize how much I have changed. When I first entered Grade 7, I was a shy and __(1)__ girl who was afraid to raise her hand in class. Now, in Grade 9, I am the class monitor who speaks confidently at school meetings.

The biggest change didn't happen overnight. It started with a small step. In Grade 7, our English teacher, Ms. Chen, asked me to __(2)__ in the English speech contest. "I can't do it," I said immediately. "I'm not good enough."

Ms. Chen didn't accept my refusal. "You'll never know __(3)__ you can do unless you try," she said firmly. With her encouragement, I agreed to participate.

Preparing for the contest was painful. I stood in front of a mirror every evening, practicing my speech again and again. Sometimes I cried because I couldn't pronounce some words correctly. Sometimes I wanted to __(4)__. But every time I thought about giving up, Ms. Chen's words echoed (回荡) in my mind.

The day of the contest, my legs were shaking as I walked onto the stage. The bright lights blinded me for a moment, and I could hear my heart __(5)__ loudly. I took a deep breath and began.

I don't remember exactly what happened next. All I remember is that when I finished, the audience (观众) applauded (鼓掌). I didn't win first place, but I won something more important — I conquered (征服) my fear of speaking in __(6)__.

Since then, I have volunteered for many activities: school plays, debate contests, and community service projects. Each experience has helped me grow a little more. I have learned that growth is like climbing a mountain — you don't reach the __(7)__ overnight. You take one step at a time, sometimes slipping backward, but always moving upward if you keep going.

To all the students who feel shy or unsure of yourselves: don't be afraid to take that first step. You are stronger than you __(8)__. Believe in yourself, and the world will believe in you too.
options: (1) A. outgoing B. quiet C. active D. lazy
(2) A. watch B. judge C. join D. leave
(3) A. what B. how C. when D. where
(4) A. continue B. succeed C. practice D. quit
(5) A. beating B. breaking C. burning D. jumping
(6) A. class B. public C. private D. English
(7) A. tree B. hill C. top D. bottom
(8) A. expect B. hope C. think D. know
analysis:
(1) B【考查形容词辨析】quiet安静的/内向的，shy and quiet又害羞又安静（前后并列）；outgoing外向的（相反）；active活跃的（相反）；lazy懒的（不相关）。
(2) C【考查动词辨析】join参加，asked me to join in the contest让我参加比赛；watch观看（不是旁观）；judge评判；leave离开。老师鼓励参加用join/participate。
(3) A【考查宾语从句】what什么，You'll never know what you can do除非尝试否则永远不知道自己能做什么；how怎样；when何时；where何地。know what you can do了解自己的能力边界。
(4) D【考查动词辨析】quit放弃，sometimes I wanted to quit有时想放弃；continue继续（与give up矛盾）；succeed成功（不会想放弃）；practice练习（不会想停止练习）。想放弃的心理活动。
(5) A【考查动词辨析】beating（心脏）跳动，heart beating loudly心跳很大声；breaking打破；burning燃烧；jumping跳跃。心脏跳动beat是固定搭配。
(6) B【考查固定搭配】in public在公开场合/当众，conquered my fear of speaking in public克服了当众演讲的恐惧；in class在课堂上（范围小）；in private私下（不需克服）；in English用英语（不是核心恐惧）。
(7) C【考查名词辨析】top山顶，climbing a mountain—you don't reach the top overnight爬山不是一夜登顶；tree树；hill小山（mountain对应的顶是top）；bottom底（爬山的goal是top）。
(8) C【考查动词辨析】think认为/以为，You are stronger than you think你比你想象的更强壮（经典励志句式）；expect期待；hope希望；know知道。stronger than you think是标准励志表达。
